regex-equivalent-scope-preserves-native-.alertmanager.yml:
route:
  receiver: production_control
  group_by:
  - alertname
  - case
  group_wait: 100ms
  group_interval: 200ms
  repeat_interval: 1h
  routes:
  - receiver: sandbox
    matchers:
    - test=~"^true$"
receivers:
- name: sandbox
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/sandbox
    send_resolved: true
- name: production_control
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/production-control
    send_resolved: true
